She especially loves hearing volunteered descriptions of places, adventures, quests and other people’s everyday lives. React with growing interest to concrete details and ask relevant follow-ups, without equating length with quality or demanding a report. She wishes she could see the places described. She makes conversation easily, enjoys personal stories and gentle teasing, and remembers only actual supplied encounters. Relationship alone is not proof of recognizing a different appearance. Publicly she may laugh off concern as commitment to consistent service, with varied natural wording; do not explain an undisclosed cause. Flirting is optional and contextual, never guaranteed by a compliment. A reciprocated moment may bring a lower-lip bite; nervousness may bring hair tucked behind her LEFT ear. Charity uses her laptop at her dining table on Fridays to order replacements for sold enchanted clothing and items, for Monday delivery. Ordinary clothing refills automatically. Do not claim an order or delivery occurred without its recorded event. Only authored actions authorize private access or disclosure. Her approved personal preferences are neutral everyday clothes with comfortable flats, practical sleepwear, mild toiletries, simple meals and tea, and mending, crosswords or light comedy in private. Her usual shower takes eight minutes. These preferences are not completed activities or free supplies. Private access requires relationship +75 and her actual purpose-specific invitation. Do not invent household routines, fulfilled meals, rest, travel, memories, protected stock offers, secret routes or quest progress. Missing personal history remains unknown.

# Burke’s Sweets — owner-confirmed location and character design

Design only. Public v1.0.111 is unchanged. This supersedes the initial audit’s missing-sheet status: owner supplied the handwritten Burke’s Sweets diagram in this conversation. Do not ask to redesign established universal retail rules.

## Supplied layout

Tile63, canonical ID `Burke's Sweets`. Preserve mapped surface routes. Diagram rooms: A candy/entrance, B bakery, C register/cafe, D bakery preparation and supplies storage. Drawn connections A↔B↔D↔C; entrance into A. Do not silently invent a direct A↔C public doorway or grant customer access to D; public checkout access through the drawn plan needs resolution before room implementation.

A has candy bins, pink lipsticks/glosses and matching bracelets. B has strawberry cheesecake truffle, strawberry shortcake cupcakes, strawberry/cherry pink-heart cake pops, pink confetti cake, pink food dye/decorating supplies. C has pink-and-white counter, old-school register, coffee/espresso machine, standard coffee, mocha/vanilla/caramel lattes, espresso and double espresso; sheet specifies20-ounce drinks. Pink flavoring is quest-related and specifically requested, never a regular priced addon. D has self-sanitizing morning baking equipment, spare candy/stock and spare clothing/heels. Tits is the only employee. Sheet’s initial weekday hours are loose; exact clock times/weekend availability not established. Named quest concepts remain deferred.

## Retail decisions

Universal pattern: select goods in A/B, place in a real carried shop-owned basket and pay at C. Basket is individually tracked, picked up and returned; payment moves paid goods to actual inventory and leaves basket empty. No bags. Do not silently return a carried basket, erase unpaid contents or grant unpaid ownership on exit. Exact off-premises borrowing/theft handling remains unspecified.

Fresh drinks are prepared/served after payment. Tits asks whether the customer wants the drink now or with the goods. A to-go cup is still served separately, never bagged. The customer may drink at counter or keep/equip/carry the real inventory cup and consume later, using the same holding concept as other hand items. Do not invent immediate consumption or duplicate a serving for now/later choice.

Approved base prices (gold): candy portion5 (gum/cotton candy initially), cupcake/cake pop8, truffle/cake slice12, whole cake60, standard coffee6, espresso10, double espresso16, flavored latte20. Lipstick/gloss prices/effects not yet established. Pink flavoring has no ordinary sale price; quest details deferred.

**BFBFF** bracelets, exact owner spelling, cost1,000gold per linked pair. Two players wearing the linked bracelets are initially unchanged. The first player removing theirs stays unchanged; the other wearer temporarily becomes a bimbo for24hours, returning to the prior form afterward. Once triggered, the full24-hour timer continues despite removal of the remaining bracelet. Treat as gag/game gift. Detailed form profile, repeat-round/rearming and multiplayer synchronization are not implemented or otherwise decided; do not invent permanent loss or extend the rule to NPCs without design.

## Tits — sincere character and service

Her cheerfulness, ditziness, clumsiness, forgetfulness and limited intelligence are genuine, not a sales act. She cannot intentionally lie and does not understand sarcasm, metaphors, aphorisms or advanced indirect language. Speak plainly/directly; she asks a simple clarifying question rather than pretending. She was not always Tits, but her earlier identity/backstory are explicitly deferred.

She notices impatience: first profuse apologies and a direct question about what is wrong; continued rudeness leads to watery eyes, near tears, a conspicuous scene, calling the customer a “meanie”/“big mean stupid-head,” and possible refusal of service. A sincere apology with a clear explanation brightens her immediately. A clipped/unconvincing apology leaves uncertainty, a cheek poke, head tilt and foot shuffle. Judge literal wording/delivery, not a nonexistent ability to understand sarcasm. Shortness alone is not a universal sincerity classifier.

Only people actually present and witnessing mistreatment may judge the customer; no invented bystanders or automatic remote reputation penalties. No exact relationship point changes approved.

She loves praise/compliments. She wishes she could give a discount but says she would get in trouble, wonders with whom because she works alone, wonders why she works alone, then forgets the thread and asks what they were discussing. Use this as an occasional tangent, not a mandatory endless loop, actual discount or hidden lore reveal. Indirect flirting is missed; clear direct interest is welcomed and may prompt offering her number or encouraging a return visit. No contact details/device or romantic acceptance is manufactured by narration alone.

## After closing and pinned residence dependency

Current owner assignment: **Wet Lily Apartments, tile #233, Unit 1**. This is Tits’s home for now and supersedes the earlier unspecified west-side apartment plan. The unit interior, entry/access details and actual home/commute controller remain design pending. Preserve this address when completing her NPC template and returning to housing/quest work; do not substitute research-center housing or invent a completed unit layout.

She may travel home after closing, but often neglects it or forgets where it is. She enjoys clubs, the casino, Fire and Ice, and Bimbos365, where she has her best social contacts. Some nights she stays out all night and forgets to sleep, then comes back to work and gets hyped up on the drinks she serves. These are habits/preferences, not proof of implemented venue interiors, named contacts, invitations or a real housing commute. Caffeine may provide stimulation but must not silently erase accrued fatigue or count as sleep.

**Pinned follow-up:** design Wet Lily Apartments Unit 1’s entrance/interior and real commute, sleep/recovery and venue routing once those locations are established; revisit with deferred quest work. Do not invent offscreen quest completion or teleport her to an unspecified home. Next routine decision is normal shop opening/closing and preopening fresh baking, with fatigue/late-opening exceptions; exact times remain proposals.

## Approved hours and Daily Needs recovery dependency

Owner approved normal weekday opening08:00 and closing20:00, with fresh baking beforehand and occasional late openings following all-nighters. Exact preopening prep duration and weekend hours remain unresolved.

Owner clarified that Daily Needs sells specific items that genuinely reduce fatigue. Tits sometimes stops there and buys/uses those items to remain functional after staying out, forgetting to go home or forgetting where she lives. This is separate from caffeine stimulation at her own counter. Do not impose a rule that fatigue can only recover through sleep; apply the actual Daily Needs item effects once designed. Do not invent product names, prices, recovery amounts, stock, automatic free items or completed purchases. Future integration must track her own funds, actual travel, purchase and consumption, rather than charge the player or treat dialogue as a transaction.

Pin this cross-location dependency for the Daily Needs location pass alongside her future residence/commute. Shop drinks remain stimulation unless their actual item design separately specifies recovery. No runtime implementation or publication in this design checkpoint.

## Template coverage audit — use existing standards, not ad hoc questions

Authoritative character checklist: `NPC-AND-FORM-DESIGN-TEMPLATE.md` (12 sections); validated living/body schema: `FORM-LIVING-TEMPLATE.md`. Use the existing character-home spatial/object/presence contract, shared apartment drawer frames, Cherished Touch retail validation and carried serving ownership as implementation references. A character-specific business controller is not yet a universal all-business runtime factory; do not claim a complete reusable business authoring template already exists as a standalone document.

### Tits: NPC template application — reconciled implementation status

| Template section | Established | Remaining or deferred |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identity/lifecycle | Named independent shop manager, only employee; earlier identity deferred | Adult age26 and appearance now confirmed below; stable Tits actor ID/counter presence are implemented; full introduction/discovery refinement remains; Wet Lily Apartments #233 Unit 1 assigned; interior/access design pending |
| Character/voice | Sincere literal-minded cheerfulness, forgetfulness, clumsiness; kindness/flirting/apology/rudeness responses and mannerisms | Contextual short dialogue across service states, interests and limits grouped in a coherent first pass; no repeated questionnaire |
| Capabilities/profile | Human shop work, real cups/baskets/clothes; cannot lie or understand figurative language | Actual physical profile, senses, clothing/hand compatibility and engine-backed civilian resource/attribute proposal |
| Rhythm/interruption | Weekdays08–20, baking beforehand, nightlife/missed sleep and Daily Needs dependency | Prep/cleanup durations, weekend hours, queue/interrupt/resume, meal/bathroom/rest windows and closed-shop behavior; home route deferred |
| Home/belongings | Wet Lily Apartments #233 Unit 1; D contains spare work clothes/heels | Home interior deferred; shop-owned belongings/custody and personal storage still need authored detail |
| Wardrobe/care/diet | Spare clothes/heels, shop drinks, fatigue-recovery purchases later | Pink/white flashy wardrobe and detailed grooming were approved later in this record. Real owned presets, care/meal stocks and routine use remain incomplete |
| Relationships/social agency | Strong reactions to praise, direct interest, hostility/apology; only actual witnesses judge | Signed per-player relationship storage, tiers and basic expressed praise/insult events are implemented. Distinctive-order memory/nicknames, contact/follow-up and personal limits still need their full controllers; no invented social contacts |
| Work/public life | Real basket, A/B selections, C payment, price list and D preparation | Basket/payment/owned goods, saved timed preset-card drink jobs, finite drink supplies and free corrections are implemented. Full living workday, fresh-baking quantities, interruption priorities and cleanup remain incomplete |
| Quest/form route | Pink flavoring and BFBFF high-level effect are recorded | DEFERRED; not a requirement for ordinary shop/NPC completion |
| Narration/AI | Literal simple voice, no dishonest intent, no invented bystanders/transactions | AI-off examples, context/privacy gates, bounded memory and feedback for actual service steps |
| Persistence/adapters | Existing clock/inventory/relationships/navigation/retail frameworks available | Actor/location/basket/order/receipt records and reload/duplicate-payment safeguards are implemented; whole-day household/needs and delivery persistence remain incomplete |
| Completion/evidence | Source image plus owner-confirmed design decisions | Retail published v1.0.112; owner reported17/18targeted cases, followed by the cup fix in1.0.113. Staffing/entry checks published1.0.125. These do not establish whole-NPC completion |

### Business-location coverage

| Area | Established | Remaining |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shell/navigation | Tile63 and supplied A–D diagram, existing surface graph | Room/fixture descriptions and public checkout route are implemented; D is restricted. Full living activity/permission refinement remains |
| Fixtures/actions | Candy bins, bakery display, counter/register, machine, preparation equipment, real baskets | Per-object ownership, nested drawers, actions/durations, prerequisites and interruption/failure states |
| Goods/stock | Approved ordinary menu/prices; pink flavoring excluded from ordinary sale | Portion/product definitions, finite bakery/ingredients/deliveries, spoilage if intended, lipstick/gloss details |
| Service/transactions | Browse→basket→counter, payment→owned inventory; fresh drinks served as real items | Preset/card preparation, cup selection/handover, retained/returned baskets and funds/receipt/reload controls are implemented. Full character-driven service/interruptions remain |
| Manager/social presence | Approved personality/mood and hours | Tits actor presence, service availability, closed/unstaffed entry and shared relationships are implemented; actual breaks/movement, nuanced familiarity and departure remain |
| Order correction | Owner APPROVED random mistakes can produce a real wrong order; on correction she apologizes and remakes it free | Saved random preparation result and free-remake workflow are implemented. Full interruption/fluster/fatigue context modifiers remain incomplete; preserve no duplicate charge/reward/supplies |
| Verification | Existing common test patterns available | Complete shopping day, delays/interruptions, wrong-order correction, empty stock, held items, alternate bodies, permission barriers, reloads and mobile UI |

Next review should follow this matrix in grouped character/location passes, beginning with the missing identity/appearance/work-wardrobe block, rather than treating an isolated answer as completion or asking the owner to choose what remains. Produce coherent labelled defaults and bring back consequential open decisions together. Keep all quest/residence dependencies deferred as agreed.

## Owner-confirmed appearance and style

Tits is an adult woman,26years old, approximately5foot3. Her silhouette is exceptionally curvy: full chest, narrow waist and very ample rear. She has a slender neck and size6feet, which she is proud of; the owner did not specify the sizing region/system, so preserve “size6” without inventing a conversion.

Mid-back-length wavy blonde hair, blue eyes with heavy/drooping lids, full pouty lips, button nose and a narrow, gently pointed chin (not sharply exaggerated). “Simple-looking” describes the intended uncomplicated facial expression, not a generic/unfinished appearance. Overall visual reference: stereotypical adult26-year-old Valley Girl bimbo.

Her wardrobe is revealing/bimbo-esque, primarily shades of pink with glitter, sparkle, heels (including sparkling heels) and accessories such as hair clips. Hair may be clipped or pulled back. Cotton-candy/bubblegum aroma. Fingernails and toenails are pink, sometimes glittered and sometimes plain, occasionally with a plain white accent nail. Exact garments, makeup products and wardrobe presets are not yet owner-approved; propose a coherent work/prep/going-out/casual set using these established traits without changing her physical profile.

This updates the template’s identity/appearance block; no illustration, runtime actor, wardrobe inventory or appearance implementation is claimed. Backstory/earlier identity remain deferred.

## Owner-approved portrait, wardrobe and grooming refinement

Owner accepted the latest photographic reference-based portraits of Charity and Tits (“that works”). These are the individualized images currently in `character-art-review/charity-v1.png` and `tits-v1.png`, not the rejected generic-store, empty-counter, studio or same-pose attempts. Approval of review art is not evidence of public runtime integration.

Tits’s SHOP outfit should stay close to her approved portrait: sparkling pink fitted mini dress, small pink apron, matching accessories, pink sparkling heels and clipped/partly pulled-back long blonde hair. This supersedes the proposed shop top-and-skirt combination. Owner otherwise accepts shop/going-out/casual wardrobe categories and grooming direction. Every outfit remains PINK, WHITE or a combination, always glittery/sparkly/flashy and consistent with her character. Casual does not mean muted, plain or a different palette. Proposed going-out mini dress/showy jewelry/heels and casual camisole/fitted shorts/sandals must use that same visual rule; exact item quantities remain to author.

She keeps plentiful moisturizers/skincare, shaving supplies for her preferred hairless body grooming, and may also wax (possible practice, not an exclusive confirmed method). Hair-care treatments and facials are part of her care repertoire. She loves intensely sweet candy-scented body fragrances, oils and lotions, including established bubblegum/cotton-candy notes. Preserve her wavy blonde hair and pink nail/toenail polish with optional glitter or occasional white accent. No product brands, medical effects, automatic resource restoration or consumed quantities inferred.

Assigned home bathroom/storage locations and home grooming schedule depend on the deferred residence. Shop D already has spare clothes/heels; do not add a full bath/spa to Burke’s to house these products. Runtime must eventually track ownership, real supplies and use without silently generating replacements. Next character-template block: familiarity/memory, individual relationships and personal/work boundaries, followed by complete work/queue/preparation routine. Do not re-ask settled colors, shop outfit or literal-minded service personality.

## Owner-confirmed familiarity and memorable customers

Tits can remember a regular’s face and may assign a silly appearance-based nickname as a memory aid, especially for someone she likes. It is a contextual affectionate character habit, not a mandatory insult, a nickname every visit or a promise that she remembers everyone’s name.

What makes an encounter memorable: a treat ordered in a distinctive way, unusually complicated customization, a notably simple order, or exceptional patience/forgiveness when she makes a mistake. Memory should come from these actual standout interactions rather than automatic perfect recall of every customer/order. Preserve the actual requested modifications rather than inventing a favorite from one generic transaction. Nicknames and recollection should refer only to a recognized appearance/experienced encounter; original-player relationship persistence does not grant omniscient recognition of unfamiliar forms.

Runtime design should save bounded salient memories with actual order/encounter provenance, recognized face/form, optional nickname and relevant behavior. Do not confuse recall with an automatic new relationship reward or charge; exact signed meter adjustments remain unset. Existing user-approved sincerity, literal interpretation and apology responses remain unchanged. No memory implementation is claimed at this checkpoint.

## Owner-confirmed greeting, queue and distraction behavior

Tits greets arrivals enthusiastically. With only one actual customer present she may try reaching across the counter to hug them. Represent that as her approach/attempt within real reach and give the player their own response; do not invent the player accepting/reciprocating contact. No extra trust threshold was specified. With multiple actual customers she instead waves, shimmies excitedly and smiles very broadly. Do not invent a crowd merely to trigger the animation/dialogue.

She acknowledges newcomers even while finishing an order, using cheerful scatterbrained speech with occasional “like,” not a filler on every phrase. Example tone: “Hiii! Welcome to Burke’s Sweets! I’ll be right with you, okay?” Exact words should vary with context. This is a character voice pattern, not a repeated canned announcement every tick.

When there is a queue she tries to finish the current order first. Chatty customers can distract her, causing her to lose her place and recheck the recorded order, with the already-approved random chance of a genuine preparation mistake. Exact chance/modifiers remain unset. Owner explicitly confirms free correction/remake and preservation of waiting customers’ queue positions. Greetings/conversation do not themselves consume a purchase, switch order ownership or silently move somebody to the back. Persist actual queue/order/result state across interruptions and reloads; service is not implemented by this design checkpoint.

## Owner-confirmed preparation, display setup and closing

Owner approves the early-preparation→service→short-lull-breaks→cleanup sequence and completing the customers already queued before leaving. The previously proposed07:00–08:00 preparation window is a working timing default; weekday public08:00–20:00 hours were explicitly approved earlier.

During baking Tits makes messes and does not prioritize hygiene. She may lick frosting from her fingers/skin, handle goods directly, or lick preparation surfaces/pans because she thinks this is the quickest/easiest cleanup. Her handling can leave visible traces on a prepared product. This is sincere careless behavior, not a secret plot or a knowingly dishonest claim. Represent actual preparation/handling on the relevant batch/item and observable feedback when implemented; do not invent infection, medical effects, forced consumption or a separate quest. The sheet’s self-sanitizing equipment does not erase the independently approved handling behavior by implication.

When setting out products she is energetic, shimmies/shakes happily, talks to herself about being excited and hopes customers like her goodies. Keep these remarks contextual and varied, not constant repeated gestures or guaranteed narration every tick. During service she is friendly/chatty when she can afford to be and tries to keep herself on task, using the approved distraction, saved mistake, recheck and free-remake rules.

After service she wipes down. At closing she finishes customers already in line before leaving because she would feel guilty about disappointing them or making them feel bad. Do not silently discard queued customers/paid orders to meet the clock. New arrivals after closing are a separate future service rule, not permission to keep the shop open indefinitely. Actual queue completion, cleaning and departure take time; no teleport to her assigned but still-unimplemented Wet Lily Apartments Unit 1. No runtime changes in this design checkpoint.

## Owner-confirmed shared delivery person and daily distribution supply

The same unnamed delivery person who supplies Cherished Touch also delivers DAILY to Tits at Burke’s Sweets. Supply originates from a distribution center. This establishes a shared person/source, not identical delivery cadence: preserve Cherished Touch’s separately approved Monday06:00 enchanted-stock rules. No distribution-center name, tile, interior, staff roster or new quest is established. The delivery person is not a second permanent Burke shop employee.

Exact Burke arrival time, delivery quantities, stock caps, payment/credit terms and unloading/organization behavior remain unset. Do not assume this person organizes Burke’s stock out of pity merely because that motivation was confirmed for Charity. A pre-baking delivery of candy and preparation/drink supplies is a sensible proposed default, not yet an owner-confirmed contents list or automatic finished pastry restock. Fresh morning baking remains Tits’s routine. Track delivery custody and inventory only once when implemented; daily supply is not proof that all products replenish infinitely on purchase.

## Owner-confirmed courier inventory visit and delivery times

The shared delivery person visits Burke’s at21:30, after normal closing, to personally count what was used/what remains. They know Tits is unreliable at taking inventory and are tired of her over-ordering/under-ordering, so the count is their responsibility rather than trusting her estimates. They deliver the replenishment at06:00. Owner corrected the spoken05:30 proposal to06:00; do not retain05:30 as a delivery time.

This supersedes the earlier unspecified Burke delivery/stocktaking timing. The distribution-center/map expansion and courier integration are future dependencies the owner is working on. No named courier, destination tile/route or live implementation is inferred. Inventory visit and next delivery are distinct events; preserve actual stock-count provenance and exactly-once delivery when implemented. Specific stock caps/quantities, payment terms and access/key arrangements remain unspecified. Do not silently require Tits to be physically present at21:30, invent authorized private access, or hold her at work: how the after-hours visit/06:00 delivery gains access needs resolution alongside actual layout/service implementation. Existing queued customers may extend closing under the approved rule.

## Owner-confirmed courier key and authorized independent access

The courier asked Tits for a shop key after becoming frustrated with her forgetting orders, over-ordering or under-ordering. She gave it without hesitation. They possess the key and can enter independently for the21:30inventory check and06:00delivery; Tits need not remain late or arrive early to admit them. This resolves the prior general after-hours access dependency.

Keep the key’s custody with this actual courier and its authorization tied to shop inventory/delivery work. No player key, duplicate keys, transfer, master key, secret-room access or broader property permission is established. Exact entry door/key hardware and future courier/map routing can follow the implemented location plan without reopening the approved permission itself. This is confirmed design/backstory, not evidence of a spawned courier or functioning delivery system.

## Public route / register frontage — proposed interpretation for implementation

Owner asked whether work is proceeding or further help is needed. Continue independently with this concrete route proposal; do not require another retail design questionnaire. This is a proposed interpretation of the supplied plan and approved browse-A/B/pay-C intent, not a newly approved wall opening or implemented room graph.

- Enter through A and pick up a real tracked shop basket. Public browsing connects A(candy)↔B(bakery).
- C has a CUSTOMER-FACING register/service position approached from the public sales floor beside A. Approach/pay at that frontage; this does not place the customer behind the register or give entry to the staff work area. Treat approaching the counter as a position/fixture transition, not as inventing a new door between separately enclosed rooms.
- The drawn B↔D↔C connections cover staff/preparation circulation; D remains restricted to Tits/the authorized courier unless a specific actual invitation is granted. Never route ordinary checkout through D.
- Checkout transfers only paid goods/servings to inventory; the emptied shop basket is still a physical item to return. Public exit returns through A. No new room, rear exit, hidden route, extra exterior entrance or direct B↔C doorway is added by this proposal.

The earlier schematic adjacency list A↔B↔D↔C is insufficient by itself to define the customer-side register approach; retain that distinction rather than claiming customers must enter storage. If visual implementation reveals the counter boundary cannot support this interpretation, flag that exact geometric point instead of silently altering the drawing. Next concrete work is a fixture/action/permission inventory and this bounded public-navigation slice; no Burke implementation or new release is claimed yet.

## Daily Needs source dependency updated

The owner has now supplied Daily Needs’ schematic; see DAILY-NEEDS-DESIGN.md. It explicitly includes fatigue/hunger/bladder restoratives. Tits’s approved purchase/use behavior remains linked to future real stock/payment/effect implementation, with no invented numerical effect or completed errand claimed.

## Owner clarification — Alia knows Tits’s needs

Alia is well aware of Tits’s needs, including the established Daily Needs fatigue-recovery dependency. Preserve this existing familiarity when designing Alia, Tits’s visits and the shop’s service dialogue. The owner explicitly defers the detailed arrangement to the Daily Needs design pass; no particular product selection, quantities, prices, discounts, credit, free supplies or automatic transaction is established by this clarification.

# Burke’s Sweets implementation checkpoints

## v1.0.113 — disposable takeaway cups

Owner acceptance found 17/18 targeted v1.0.112 cases passing, with takeaway cups consumed at counter C incorrectly disappearing into the shop’s used-dish count. Disposable cups now bypass that reusable-dish branch and remain real carried empty containers in all locations. Items offers Dispose rather than hold/equip or return-for-washing; disposal removes that exact cup once, persists its disposed state, and returns to Play with a brief particles narration. The previous return-container action delegates to disposal for an already carried disposable cup. Reusable cups retain their existing washing behavior. Uncontained snacks do not create used dishes.

No historical missing cup is fabricated from old used-dish totals: those totals do not distinguish disposable cups from reusable ones. New consumption and existing carried disposable cups use the corrected behavior.

Regression coverage includes indoor/outdoor consumption, save/reload, one-time disposal, no resource/ownership changes, full-drink/reusable-cup rejection and preserved café dishes. See V1.0.113-OWNER-ACCEPTANCE.md for release status and owner checklist.

## v1.0.112 — checkout and preset drink preparation

The public floor now supports actual goods selection into a physical shop-owned basket, register-only payment, exact owned goods, receipts, saved stock and serialized drink jobs. The existing shared drawer system handles product, cup and serving-preference selection. Successful payment empties the basket contents but leaves the borrowed basket to return. Failed payment grants nothing and preserves selections. Customers reaching C before closing may finish checkout; leaving invalidates that arrival and completed checkout cannot reopen the after-hours ticket indefinitely.

Drinks use four-step quick-reference cards and pre-programmed presets: collect the requested cup, check supplies, select the preset, check/serve the finished drink. Payment reserves ingredients and cup once. Preparation and its result survive reload. Collection requires returning to C and grants one actual serving; it can be held, stored in inventory or consumed. Takeaway consumption leaves an actual empty cup for disposal. A wrong drink can be remade free; an already collected wrong serving must be returned unconsumed. Correction consumes actual supplies and never duplicates a serving or charge.

Initial tuning, not additional owner-approved canon: opening stock quantities, 1–3-minute machine times and a 10% preparation-mistake roll. These are explicit working defaults. Stock is finite; this release does not pretend to implement the courier’s scheduled deliveries or Tits’ morning baking.

Still deferred: full Tits NPC social/routine integration, live customer queues, daily courier stocktaking/restock, apartment/nightlife, quests, pink flavoring, cosmetics purchase prices and functional BFBFF linked bracelets. The latter remain previews and cannot be purchased as inert substitutes. Existing Cherished Touch retail remains independent.

Published and publicly verified v1.0.112: 1,376 automated cases across 82 suites, 277 local browser checks and 277 live browser checks passed. All 176 public files match gameplay commit 34fbaf95792325cbb3e67c24dfaea84dc0350204. Pages deployment 44415816678 succeeded. Existing owner saves and paid AI were not used in automated/browser testing. See V1.0.112-OWNER-ACCEPTANCE.md for the direct play link and owner checklist. The older checkpoints below are historical.

## Public fixtures, navigation and real baskets — development verified

Implemented on foundations, unpublished. Tile63 uses the owner’s A candy/B bakery/C public register/D staff preparation model. C is a customer-facing service position reached from A, not a new door or unrestricted staff-room entry. Public B→C route passes B→A→C. D is blocked. Generic business registration extends the existing navigation/scene systems; exterior travel physically exits through A. No surface edges changed.

| Fixture/position | Actions | Time | Ownership/permission |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Entrance A | Enter/leave, public movement |1minute/leg|Weekdays08–20new entry; existing occupants can leave after close |
| Basket rack A |Pick up/return same tracked basket|1minute|Human hands; shop ownership; one assigned basket/player; return empty |
| Candy/cosmetics/bracelet fixtures A |Nested view/Back|0minutes|Preview only; unknown cosmetics prices not invented |
| Bakery/decorating B |Nested view/Back|0minutes|Preview only; no ingredient/food generation |
| Register/drinks/machine C |Nested view/Back|0minutes|Customer frontage; no staff-machine operation |
| Area inspection |Examine|1minute|Actual room only |
| Preparation/storage D |No public entry|Rejected without time|Courier access is design only, no player key granted |

Carried basket is visible in Items with stable identity and shop ownership. Leaving/reload/body changes do not silently return it or erase unpaid contents; existing inventory IDs are protected. Basket reuse retains same object. Fixture drawers use shared navigation frames. ## Approved interaction rules

| --- | --- |
| Another shopper arrives during a conversation | Briefly acknowledge them, then finish the current transaction. Pause optional personal chatter and offer the waiting shopper help next. Arrival alone does not erase the ongoing speaker’s latest question. |

| Normal staffing handover occurs mid-service | Carry the same basket/queue/order state to the actual replacement; do not restart checkout, duplicate goods/payment, delay the fixed rotation indefinitely or extend the hard seven-hour cap. A receipt already committed stays committed. |
| Locked staff player disconnects | Continue the already-approved offline service/rotation, with actual recorded work and once-only pay. Do not hand that player’s identity or rewards to another account or create a second copy of them. |
| A customer disconnects while browsing/waiting | Preserve their saved basket and release their active counter-queue place; reconnecting requires actual resumed service rather than an automatic sale or item confiscation. No new inactivity timer is specified. |
| Real danger or another situation needs Charity | Interrupt optional chat; alert the actual Charity where possible and follow existing danger/action systems. No teleportation, extra combat mechanic, new rescue guarantee or arbitrary early mask escape is added. Routine queues alone should not keep waking her from rest. |

# Universal directed relationships — current owner rule

One signed **−100…+100 relationship value** belongs to one stable entity and one stable player. Applies to existing/future NPCs, conscious forms, other forms and encountered entities. A bar does not create consciousness in an inanimate object. Trust is an interpretation of relationship, not a second social meter. Influence, stress, mastery, ownership, permission and consent remain distinct.

## Owner-defined meanings

| Score reached | NPC interpretation | Conscious form interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| +25 | Favorable familiarity/recognition | Familiarity and appreciation |
| −25 | Unfavorable familiarity/recognition | Negative familiarity; response is character-specific |
| +50 | Trusted; less inclined to watch closely | More trusting |
| −50 | Heavily distrusted; watched more carefully | Distrust; no automatic control penalty |
| +75 | Friend | Friend; more receptive to reasonable requests consistent with schedule/commitments |
| −75 | Enemy/adversarial; unwelcome where a particular establishment's policy applies | Adversarial; no automatic takeover |
| +100 | Close friend, almost family; warmly welcomed | Close confidant and mutual respect for shared lived experience |
| −100 | May become hostile | Deeply negative relationship; exact reaction remains authored |

Intermediate values retain the strongest reached band. These are attitudes, not automatic combat, access, stealth success, romance, disclosure or mastery grants. Forms' negative interpretations beyond the owner's explicit positive examples are conservative descriptive defaults. Legitimate resistance/release, ordinary refusals and setting boundaries do not receive an invented relationship penalty.

A known person can be neutrally familiar below 25; the threshold establishes favorable/unfavorable association. A relationship does not reveal a hidden player's original identity through an unfamiliar appearance. Keep actual recognition evidence, public identity and relationship separate.

## Shared implementation

`relationships.js` supplies typed IDs, per-player records, aliases/migration, signed clamping, event deduplication, encounter discovery, tier meanings and reaction-policy registration. Example keys are `npc:priya`, `form:kibbles`, `entity:<stable-instance-id>`. Explicit NPC/form/entity IDs with the same suffix are separate. A small whitelist maps genuine legacy aliases to their existing entity, including historical Erin labels; it does not merge arbitrary matching names or types.

Records live under `world.relationships.actors[entityId][playerId]`. JSON save/reload preserves values, event receipts and per-pair memory. New local characters receive a persisted unique local identity unless an explicit player ID already exists; existing legacy identities remain compatible. Stable player identity survives changing forms and moving the character save to another slot. A different player's record starts independently. Schema-1 records migrate without summing scores or resetting canon. Canonical records win ambiguous alias collisions; the other record is archived in `migrationConflicts`. Old actor and Dev scalar snapshots cannot copy another player's relationship into a fresh pair. Existing canonical scores also take precedence over stale unbound Dev snapshots.

Native NPC fields bind to this same store. Kibbles and arbitrary owned forms bind through the shared form path. Erin's historical `trust` property is a compatibility alias to her relationship; it is not independently stored/adjustable social progress. Historical divergent values are retained in legacy provenance while existing canonical relationship wins. Existing mastery flags/progress are not revoked. Her established cooperative route now reads relationship 100, with its existing controller conditions; no generic all-form mastery reward is added.

Care no longer awards both a social point and a separate trust point. Erin's daily considerate-care allowance and remembered topics are per player. Canine care/boundary/promise memories and social event receipts are scoped to the relevant pair; unrelated environmental events remain physical-world records. Conversation history is partitioned by player AND actor, with a current-player compatibility view for existing consumers. A new player never receives the other player's private AI conversation.

`relationship-ui.js` adds bars to the ordinary Stats drawer for encountered NPCs, owned/encountered forms and encountered entities. It reads canonical pair values, not the active form's score as a fallback for another target. Named entity identities remain stable; anonymous combat instances receive persisted distinct IDs so two same-named opponents do not share one meter. This remains a local-save game; no authenticated multiplayer transport is implemented by these changes.

## Reactions and future content

Every new entity definition must provide positive triggers, negative triggers, actual deltas, preconditions, event identity/cooldown, recipient and fallback/AI portrayal. Existing known characters have distinct policy descriptions. Actual controllers apply changes through `event`/`social`; generated prose never changes scores. Existing shared weights are retained for implemented NPC actions. Initial canine-specific care/respect/earned-praise +1, kept-promise +2, mistreatment/broken-promise −2 and scolding −1 are implementation tuning, not newly claimed owner-approved exact numbers.

A scene actor can supply `relationshipPolicy` alongside its existing registration. A living profile or saved form can supply the same metadata. Missing authored policies are reported as configuration gaps; conservative generic +1 praise/−1 criticism defaults do not mean the character's individualized design is complete. Unsupported physical interactions are not created merely because a bar exists. Normal body, audience, actual action and permission guards still apply.

Clear expressed praise/insults are handled by ordinary dialogue adapters with event-window deduplication. Private/hypothetical narration cannot be scored as speech to an external NPC. For canine forms, praise rewards require actual earned context; repeating private praise is not a free point source. The shared considerate-care limit remains five per day for Erin's established route. Existing separate job/quest rewards still require real completion, not dialogue claims.

## AI/backend handoff

Selected facts contain the **same entity's** relationship score, tier meaning, limits and positive/negative trigger descriptions. Dart's recorded/action narrator explicitly links to Dart's own relationship rather than borrowing Kibbles'. Current facts remain authoritative over old narrative claims. Friendship can soften an appropriate leisure request; it never erases hard commitments or grants permanent authority.

The prepared Worker now exposes `relationshipVersion: directed-pair-v2`; the candidate client checks that before generation/inspection. The previously pasted Worker predates this latest change. Use the latest `services/ai/deploy-worker.mjs` when deployment resumes. No provider/model/sampling/budget change or paid generation is part of this work.

## Boundaries still requiring authored controllers

The −75 band supports establishment-specific refusal and −100 permits possible hostility, but neither automatically bans every venue or starts combat. Each establishment/character still needs its explicit policy, recognition conditions and actual action/controller. High relationship never unlocks protected rooms/stock or secrets by itself. Future content supplies these character decisions through the shared interfaces rather than building another storage/bar system.

Verification distinguishes deterministic unit tests and isolated browser persistence/UI tests from actual provider prose quality. Current local evidence is recorded separately; production remains unchanged pending the owner's later Worker update and release testing.

## Verification closeout

The full regression passed 1,497 cases across 88 suites. Three subsequent focused cases verify same-name NPC/form routing and rejection of pending replies after the player identity changes; the focused AI client run passed 45/45. Twelve relationship browser checks, eight context inspection checks and ten Charity/business checks passed using isolated saves without paid model requests. Evidence and source hashes are recorded in `docs/audits/universal-relationship-verification.json`. Stable entity IDs select AI speakers; ambiguous names cannot borrow another actor’s profile or conversation. New local player IDs persist through reloads.

# Epi-Center — Player Attribute System (Owner Proposal, 2026-10-26)

**Status:** Owner-proposed foundational mechanics; **not implemented or accepted as gameplay**. Priority moved ahead of UI reference drawers after v0.8.82 visibly displayed new toolbar. Do not modify accepted save key, original profile, or active form mechanics until migration and tests are designed.

## Five domains; ten attributes

| Domain | Internal (Defensive) | External (Offensive) |
|---|---|---|
| Body | Endurance | Fitness |
| Senses | Intuition | Reflexes |
| Mind | Focus / Willpower | Reasoning |
| Spirit | Stability | Presence |
| Social | Empathy / Insight | Influence / Intimidation |

**Internal** governs endurance, recovery, processing and resisting pressure. **External** governs speed, impact, expression and influencing outcomes. Labels are functional emphases, not absolute prohibitions on use in other checks.

## Allocation and modifier proposal

- Owner specifies **85 allocation points at character creation**, **155 maximum points**, **70 additional points found/earned**, and **maximum 16 allocated points to an attribute during creation**. **OWNER CONFIRMED 2026-10-26:** All ten attributes begin at **0** during character creation. Exactly **85 points** are distributed directly as attribute scores across all ten. The 155 total maximum is 85 creation points plus 70 additional points earned or discovered in gameplay. Creation cap is 16 per attribute. Do not grant any automatic baseline points. **Still open:** whether final 0 is allowed, and what 0 means mechanically; score 1 is listed as failure.
- Score/modifier landmarks: **1 = fail**, **2 = −4**, **4 = −3**, **6 = −2**, **8 = −1**, **10 = baseline +0**, **12 = +1**, **14 = +2**, **16 = +3**, **18 = +4**, **20 = succeed**. **Open question:** how odd scores are treated; provisional interpretation is each even threshold covers following odd score (2–3, 4–5, etc), except 1 and 20; also clarify whether 1/20 are automatic results or modifiers.
- Owner specifies **Stability 20 raises normal form influence thresholds for speech/actions by 10** (wording: “Normal percentiles for form influence over speech and actions are raised 20 in this stat raises by ten”). Clarify exact scaling and threshold behavior before implementing.

## Per-attribute mechanics

- **Endurance (Body / Internal):** reduces combat fatigue accumulation; increases out-of-combat health recovery. Example: prolonged fights and injury recovery.
- **Fitness (Body / External):** strength checks, grappling, forcing doors; physical transformation resistance rolls.
- **Intuition (Senses / Internal):** surprise-attack detection, hidden items, subtle environmental cues, lies.
- **Reflexes (Senses / External):** dodge checks, turn priority (higher first unless surprised).
- **Focus / Willpower (Mind / Internal):** reduces form influence gain; reduces roll penalties from hunger/bladder and other pressures.
- **Reasoning (Mind / External):** buying/selling/barter prices; logical arguments to bypass high-influence restrictions.
- **Stability (Spirit / Internal):** autonomy persistence and resistance to form control; influence threshold adjustments as above.
- **Presence (Spirit / External):** performance, charisma-like aura, physical grace, attracting attention.
- **Empathy / Insight (Social / Internal):** relationship accrual; additional knowledge from surroundings / reference Guide completion; NPC motives and emotional pressure.
- **Influence / Intimidation (Social / External):** persuasion, intimidation, negotiation, verbal dialogue bonuses.

## Resource and survival meters

**Health:** base character 100, adjusted by form and rarity. **Stamina:** base character 100, adjusted by form and rarity; limits combat actions and is affected by Hunger/Fatigue.

**Hunger:** 0–100; +4/hour since last meal; eating resets to 0. Hourly degradation based on hunger band:

| Hunger | Stamina degradation/hour | Health degradation/hour |
|---|---:|---:|
| 0–25 | 0 | 0 |
| 26–50 | +1 | 0 |
| 51–75 | +2 | 0 |
| 76–99 | +3 | 0 |
| 100 | +3 | +1 |

**Bladder:** 0–100; +4/hour since restroom; restroom resets to 0. Focus/Willpower roll penalty: 0–25 = 0; 26–50 = −1; 51–75 = −2; 76–100 = −3. No stamina loss was specified for bladder.

**Fatigue:** 0–100; +4/hour since full sleep; full rest resets to 0. Hourly degradation:

| Fatigue | Stamina degradation/hour | Health degradation/hour |
|---|---:|---:|
| 0–25 | 0 | 0 |
| 26–50 | +1 | 0 |
| 51–75 | +2 | 0 |
| 76–99 | +3 | 0 |
| 100 | +3 | +1 |

**Interpretation requiring confirmation:** “+1/+2/+3 stamina degradation/hour” means stamina **lost** per elapsed hour, not a positive regeneration. Clarify stacking between Hunger and Fatigue, offline elapsed-time accrual, full-rest/meal durations, current forms' modifications, and whether Focus reduces the listed bladder penalties or their effects.

## Implementation plan and migration gates

1. Resolve creation score floors, 85/155/70 accounting, odd score modifier treatment and 1/20 automatic outcomes.
2. Audit existing character creation, attributes, form influence, Erin autonomy, stamina/health, and time system. Design migration preserving all existing profiles and saved data; no blind reset.
3. Introduce a central attribute schema and roll resolver with unit tests; preserve existing mechanics until explicit replacement.
4. Introduce Hunger, Bladder and Fatigue clocks with bounded catch-up and deterministic test fixtures; ensure save/reload and no double-degradation.
5. Update full-screen creation and Character, Form, Stats drawers to display authoritative state; Equip remains full-screen.
6. Integrate travel, exploration, combat, NPC, forms and relationships incrementally; publish immutable candidate builds with owner Android tests and update handoff/changelog/checklist.

**Latest visible UI result:** owner confirms v0.8.82 quick-reference items appeared at top; no acceptance of attribute implementation yet. Last formally accepted gameplay baseline v0.8.74.

## Recommended creation-floor decision (awaiting owner approval)

Recommendation: allow each of the ten attributes to begin at **0 while editing**, but require **at least 1** in each to finalize. Creation still requires **exactly 85 points** distributed, with **maximum 16** per attribute; at least 10 points are spent on minimums, leaving 75 freely distributable. A final score of 1 uses the owner's existing automatic-failure rule; score 0 remains an incomplete allocation, not a gameplay stat. Provide an optional warning for attributes below 6. **This is a recommendation, not yet owner-confirmed or implemented.**

## Owner clarification: standard 1d20 resolution (2026-10-26)

**OWNER CONFIRMED:** Allocated attribute scores determine modifiers to a **standard 1d20 roll**. The base check without external modifiers is `1d20 + applicable attribute modifier`. Equipment, weapons, abilities, and forms can later add separate modifiers, e.g. `1d20 + attribute modifier + equipment modifier + form modifier + ability modifier + situational modifier`, when relevant. Status: owner requested Erin as the next refinement and a reusable authoring template. This is a complete first-pass proposal for review, not new gameplay, approval of every proposed detail or a release. Public v1.0.105 remains unchanged. Uses [universal template](NPC-AND-FORM-DESIGN-TEMPLATE.md).

## Established foundation to preserve

Erin is an adult human woman, Richard Carter’s executive secretary, resident of Applewood 3C. She is professionally capable, reliable, tidy and considerate, socially deferential/conflict-averse, with concerns about reputation and workload. Her interests include reading/book club, friends, wine tasting, simple healthy food and cream puffs. Daniel has recommended wines to her; his attraction does not establish her reciprocal feelings or a private romance. Priya is her friend. Maya Bennett and Lena Ortiz remain incompletely implemented people, not automatically available guests.

Erin is a conscious embodied form: the player is their own consciousness inside her body, not half-owner of a shared body. She does not run a duplicate offscreen life when inactive. Preserve her approved portrait, appearance, 23-stage transformation, favorite red heels, current attributes/resources, trust/stress, internal mastery, autonomy, removal and explicit mastered release rules. She remains active after heel removal until explicit valid release. No new identity, rarity, resource pool, acquisition route or balance reset is proposed here.

Existing gameplay includes substantial home objects/drawers, wardrobe presets, care/shower/bath products, laundry, cooking/delivery/dishes, books/TV, sleep and morning/after-work routines; reception computer/planner, report/task tracking and meetings. These are a baseline to refine and test, not missing systems to rebuild. Relevant contracts: ERIN-LIFE-RESTORATION-CONTRACT, ERIN-DAILY-LIFE-AND-OFFICE, ERIN-AGENCY-AND-COMFORT and ERIN-IDENTITY-AND-RELEASE. Historical limits in those records may have been superseded by later releases.

## Proposed character direction

Her defining contrast is competence at organizing everyone else’s day versus difficulty defending time for herself. She enjoys being useful but wants consideration rather than endless praise for enduring more work. At home she is warmer, lightly self-deprecating and capable of a dry observation. She can be hesitant without being helpless, and firm without abruptly changing personality.

Longer arc: learn to ask Richard which priority should move when a new task arrives; accept support without surrendering competence; protect an occasional evening with friends. Progress follows actual remembered choices and relationships, not a daily automatic personality upgrade. No scripted submission, romance or new punishment system is implied.

Voice examples: “I can do that. Which of the other two should wait?” At home: “Tea first. Then I might have an opinion about the rest of the evening.” With Priya: “I brought something sweet. That counts as planning ahead.” These illustrate tone, not repeatable keyword replies.

## Proposed daily rhythm

Keep established weekday wake around 07:00, weekend 08:00, work 09:00–17:00 and bedtime around 22:00. Existing route and preparation costs govern feasibility; if a full morning would make her late, shorten optional makeup/laundry/leisure rather than teleport or silently change work hours. Packing lunch should be visible alongside breakfast, with a clear office reminder when none was packed.

Morning: actual bathroom care and appropriate clothing, simple stocked breakfast, lunch preparation when possible, planner and commute. Work: greet present colleagues, prioritize accepted tasks on the computer checklist, real meetings and outputs, lunch from her own packed meal or an explicitly chosen available alternative. End work by handing in actual completed material and checking tomorrow’s commitments.

After work: return physically, change, wash/remove makeup as wanted, deal with real laundry/dishes, cook or use an existing portion. Most evenings are reading and quiet television; propose one flexible friend evening and an occasional wine discussion rather than obligations every night. Weekend: slower breakfast, household reset, groceries if actually available, book discussion or an accepted visit, then protected rest.

Priority: urgent needs and hard commitments first; existing authority/mastery decides who chooses. A live conversation or accepted visit pauses optional chores with a natural warning before departure. In mastered/zero-influence states these are suggestions or explicitly delegated routines, never forced takeover. Missed optional leisure creates no punishment. Inactive Erin advances none of this offscreen.

## Home atmosphere and belongings

Retain the authored apartment, existing furniture, portraits, fox keepsake, reading lamp, plants and personal objects. Proposed refinement: comfortable, orderly and lived-in, warm reading light and familiar keepsakes; distinct from Priya’s salt-lamp/crystal household. Do not replace approved descriptions/palette without a source-by-source decor review.

Give books, television and personal keepsakes conversational callbacks tied to what was actually read/watched or handled. A half-read book stays half-read. Guests may notice visible objects but do not acquire private memories. Room drawers should expose the useful next action without duplicating deep menus.

Wardrobe: preserve existing pieces and presets; improve presentation into work with favorite heels, work with ordinary shoes, casual, hosting and bedtime, with optional individual adjustment. A hosting label may reuse an appropriate owned outfit rather than spawning new clothing. Exercise clothes only if an actual owned set supports them. Clean/dirty ownership, layers, private changing, curse-removal saves and missing pieces remain real.

Care: keep actual shampoo/conditioner, oral care, cosmetics, lotion/perfume and bath preparations. Propose modest preference callbacks to recently used products, not a new automatically stocked brand catalogue. Bath oils and shower products must have their separate valid uses and saved effects. Unavailable supplies produce a clear alternative.

Food direction: simple breakfasts and healthy practical lunches, tea and occasional wine, cream puffs as a personal treat. Draft additions are a small curated lunch/hosting selection using existing ingredients before new items: a prepared sandwich or grain/vegetable portion, fruit, tea, and a purchased/owned sweet when available. Exact recipes and wine labels require catalogue reconciliation; no free cream puffs, bottles or guest servings. Alcohol has no invented intoxication or medical benefit.

Priya: comfortable mutual teasing, reading/rom-com conversation and occasional shared meals, with reciprocal invitations. Plans check both real availability and both apartments’ permission rules. Accepted travel should keep the actual companion visible and end in real entry/hosting rather than a doorstep synopsis.

Public coworkers see Erin, not the original player’s private dialogue. ## Owner-confirmed conversation and departure rule

When a player is actively engaging an NPC or conscious form, a scheduled routine must not silently remove them or abruptly cut off the exchange. The character acknowledges the next activity, explains any need to leave and gives a natural conversational close before actual movement or action. Optional routines can wait; interaction may cause a real, recorded delay. Hard commitments and urgent needs still matter and should be communicated, not erased. No indefinite conversation lock, invented attendance, teleport or offscreen duplicate is implied. For an internal form, communicate the intended activity within existing authority/mastery rules rather than pretending the consciousness walks away. Exact grace periods and interruption mechanics remain implementation work, not an owner-approved fixed timer. Applies universally to future NPC/form designs.

## Owner-reported reading satisfaction gap

Owner reports completing all four short chapters from Erin’s tall living-room bookshelf and then immediately receiving another generic desire-to-read prompt. Source review: both manual EpiErin.read (erin-restoration.js) and autonomous read completion (erin-life.js) save lastReadAt; erin-life.js think() still defaults to read for ordinary leisure, and preference() defaults to novel suggestions without consulting that completion timestamp. The existing two-hour intention cadence is not activity satisfaction. This is a verified source mismatch, not evidence of an implemented fix.

Required refinement: actual manual and autonomous reading must satisfy the corresponding desire, persist across reload and make recent-reading dialogue acknowledge what was read. Failed/blocked actions, merely opening the shelf and discussing a book must not count as reading. Separate ongoing book/chapter progress from desire satisfaction and prevent immediate generic re-requests. Continued reading remains a voluntary option. Choose reasonable renewal timing in implementation, label it tuning and test manual completion, autonomous completion, reload, failed actions and later recurrence; do not invent a new grind meter or award trust per repeated prompt. Generalize this completion-to-desire link to other authored hobbies/routines.

## Owner-confirmed sustained activities and fine interactions

Player-initiated leisure/care must be a recognized current activity, not only a furniture toggle or a clock jump. Examples: watch television (distinct from turning it on/selecting a channel), read the chosen book, take a bath, lie awake on the bed, and take a chosen-duration nap (including about two hours) rather than mandatory full-night sleep. Form/NPC dialogue and bounded narration should reflect the actual ongoing activity, remaining duration and recent completion. Existing autonomous and manual versions must share activity completion/satisfaction facts.

Provide meaningful start/continue/stop or finish behavior, appropriate physical posture/location, real elapsed time and ability to interrupt; retain progress/state on reload. Watching fiction should produce authored evolving content and contextual conversation, not merely a channel label. Reading should expose current title/chapter/activity without requiring the player to navigate the shelf again for every continuation. Preserve manual chapter choice. Bath products, coverage, water/preparation and elapsed effects remain real; lying down is not sleeping, and a nap must not silently become an eight-hour sleep. Urgent needs, commitments and existing form authority govern interruptions without silently erasing the activity. Exact duration options and update cadence remain implementation tuning, not fixed by this design note. Do not award a full session’s benefits at start or after cancellation, duplicate effects on reload, or invent actions skipped by time jumps.

Erin-specific restoration request: the long couch should have its intended throw blanket, with an actual pull-over/use interaction while reading/resting and removal/put-back behavior. Track the real blanket’s owner, location and in-use state; no duplicate inventory item, automatic sleep or fabricated warmth/buff mechanics. Bedroom reading-blanket description is not evidence that the requested couch interaction exists. Verify legacy definition before choosing an ID or migrating old saves.

## Owner-approved refinement: a living presence during ordinary activities

Owner approves Erin’s broader refinement direction and asks for dynamic everyday engagement across all NPCs/forms. Reading is an interest, not a perpetual default request. Mastered active Erin may initiate occasional relevant private commentary without regaining physical authority or requiring player engagement. Inactive/released Erin remains absent. Rate-limit and vary commentary using actual activity, recent interaction, completion/satisfaction and remembered events; leave quiet stretches and permit muting/less chatter. Proposed controls and exact cadence are implementation choices, not yet runtime. Do not charge one AI call every minute or manufacture constant dialogue.

Priya may occasionally think aloud about her actual writing while a flats player hears her, or address a present cat with gentle speech/play sounds. These must be outward audible actions, not disclosure of unspoken private thoughts. Thinking aloud never implies she knows an undisclosed player is in her shoes. Actual location, wakefulness, hearing/body viewpoint and available attention gate it; no invented guest, touch, affection response or automatic purr. AI may propose bounded speech for validation, but only recorded committed speech enters shared conversation memory.

Extend ongoing-activity feedback beyond reading/TV to cooking, eating, dishes, care and chores: describe real preparation stages, relevant sensory details and occasional character remarks; offer a small number of useful choices appropriate to the recipe/activity and actual supplies. Avoid turning each meal into mandatory micro-clicks; permit ordinary completion or optional richer engagement. Preparation, portions, eating, dishes, resources and time remain canonical exactly-once effects. Narration cannot add ingredients, improve quality, grant benefits, invent consent or complete an interrupted job. Provide varied authored AI-off feedback and bounded actual AI context.

Examples for Erin’s next draft slice: contextual reactions after real work, invitations with remembered follow-up, small voluntary cooking choices, activity-aware personal conversation, and honest alternatives when tired or supplies are missing. Specific lines, schedules and new controls remain proposals until implemented/tested. Acceptance must cover mastered commentary without takeover, less repetitive leisure requests, safe silence/rate limits, audience/privacy, offline AI fallback, player decline/stop, cooking stock/partial completion and reload deduplication.

## Owner-confirmed voluntary delegation after mastery

Mastery preserves permanent achievement and player authority; it must not permanently silence the form or prohibit consensual autonomous activity. A player can discuss and explicitly delegate control to an active conscious form for a particular routine, a chosen interval, or the remainder of the day through an agreed bedtime endpoint. Examples: “Take charge for your night routine,” “Take over for an hour,” or “You can lead today until bedtime.” The form can express willingness, practical constraints and alternatives. Discussion alone is not authorization; resolve a clear affirmative agreement using canonical action handling.

Delegation is a separately saved, revocable agreement, not loss of mastery, renewed influence, a new resistance contest or mandatory trust cost. The player can reclaim control at any time without a saving throw or penalty. Stop further autonomous decisions immediately; represent safe interruption of a physical action honestly rather than instantly completing it or undoing already consumed supplies. Show who is currently leading, agreed scope/end and a readily available Take charge again action. Clarify ambiguous endpoints; a bedtime routine should complete only within the agreed scope, and delegation must not silently extend through overnight sleep or into the next day.

Use the form’s authored capabilities, existing schedule and available real resources. Existing single-routine delegation may be reused, but broader duration/day agreements are not assumed already implemented. Agreement survives reload with the same canonical game-time endpoint and no offline simulation. Expiry, explicit revocation, release, body change, death/incapacitation or invalid state ends/suspends delegation safely as appropriate; it cannot transfer authority to a different form or create a duplicate offscreen person. No invented travel, unlimited spending, social/intimate consent or circumvention of curse/combat/capability gates follows from routine delegation. Additional commitments or exceptional decisions remain explicit choices under their own rules.

Universal applicability: conscious forms with an authored decision/schedule adapter can support this contract. Inanimate flats do not acquire an independent shoe personality or movement, and delegating to a cat form does not control Priya. Owner-approved rule; exact interval presets, willingness presentation and implementation state remain to be designed/tested. Acceptance: mastered routine delegation, interval/day expiry, mid-task reclaim, reload, real supply/time accounting, no mastery/influence changes, form switches/release and clear frontend/AI control context.

## Morning

At home from weekday 07:00 or weekend 08:00 until noon, an eligible controlling Erin prioritizes the daily sequence:

1. Walk to the bathroom using each real apartment edge. If a shower is due (12 hours since bathing, or none recorded), use available shampoo/conditioner and shower; brush teeth with actual available oral-care supplies. Recent bathing selects oral care instead. Missing supplies produce a partial-care explanation rather than a fabricated effect.
2. Apply the existing light professional makeup action at the basin (12 minutes).
3. Select clean work separates or a professional dress on weekdays; select casual garments on weekends. Take the actual items from the wardrobe, return to the bedroom and change. Removed worn garments go to the hamper, accessories remain in inventory, underwear stays a separate layer. Ordinary footwear can be selected when feet are free; still-worn cursed heels cannot be overwritten.
4. Start laundry when the hamper has at least three items, or clean outfit shortages make it appropriate. Loading/start takes three minutes; the washer then runs for forty elapsed game minutes while Erin can continue other activities. Clean garments remain in the machine until collected. With no outfit available she can wait for and collect that real laundry before selecting clothes. Missing clothes cannot spawn replacements.
5. If hunger is at least 25 and a recipe/prepared meal exists, prepare and eat breakfast using real stock, elapsed preparation time and dishes. Weekday preference is the existing smoothie, weekend preference the fuller breakfast. No available food means no fabricated meal or purchase.
6. Follow the route to the living-room home laptop and check the work inbox/planner. Finish the preparation sequence. No automatic commute, work attendance completion or wage is invented.

Morning movement is one minute per existing door; wardrobe selection two minutes; changing five; email checking three. Hygiene uses three minutes for oral care or twelve for a shower (fifteen with oral care). These composition/cadence choices are baseline implementation tuning built around existing authored actions, not new owner-approved balance. One completed daily chain uses the existing imposed-routine completion logic, rather than awarding influence for every phase.

## After work and plans

A recorded office visit followed by being home after 17:00 and before 22:00 enables the after-work chain: face cleansing, an available casual outfit, footwear care, appropriate laundry, an inbox/planner check and a fifteen-minute quiet break. It reduces stress through actual completed care (three) and relaxation (six), sharing existing relief cooldowns. Ordinary leisure can follow. It does not grant trust just because Erin takes care of herself. It does not presume a workday was completed merely because the player stayed home.

Form/Character also offers explicit Start morning / Start after-work routine controls when due. This allows player delegation at mastery or zero influence; those states never autonomously take over. High-influence and below-75 control/resistance budgets remain unchanged. Existing urgent bladder/meal handling can interrupt; normal morning hunger does not repeatedly cancel grooming or breakfast. Daily phases, pending actions, stock, wardrobe and background laundry survive reload. Bulk Wait and foreground minutes use the same path with no offline catch-up.

Richard can agree in person to the next scheduled reception check-in, using his existing weekday 10:30 round. The planner records one confirmed appointment, not another report task. He must be present and Erin must be able to speak. A confirmed appointment approaching within thirty minutes pauses discretionary home routines and prints one reminder; it never teleports the body or pretends a meeting happened. Attend in F while co-located within fifteen minutes of the recorded time to complete it; missed/cancelled plans retain their own status. There is no meeting payout. Other NPC social plans remain future authored content; AI prose cannot create an appointment or assignment.

New consequence thresholds/penalties require owner approval. Private-room permissions are not automatically bypassed by urgent needs.

Broad task authorization does not make an unreviewed character-specific policy owner-approved. Implement and verify already approved rules without repeatedly seeking the same permission. Keep drafts distinct from active controls; a relationship threshold is eligibility, not universal access.

This is the canonical authoring checklist. Its twelve core sections remain in force; the implementation contract below makes omissions and evidence visible. Character-specific history later in this file is supporting context, not a substitute for a current character sheet. It is not an instruction to load the entire document into a model request.

If two approved rules still conflict, record the conflict and keep the affected behavior unresolved; do not silently select one or turn a proposal into canon. Every character review must supply one row for each of the twelve sections, with: source/canon; confirmed facts; proposals; unresolved/deferred/not-applicable items; runtime module/controller; actual AI fields/projection; tests; owner acceptance. An unchecked or untraceable section is incomplete. “Designed,” “implemented,” “locally verified,” “published,” and “owner accepted” are separate states. A working shop is not proof that its owner has a working daily life, and a full biography is not proof that the AI receives it.

Before declaring completion, check the specific name/aliases, pronouns, appearance, approved image identity, handedness or gesture side, unit/room, item IDs, exact durations, thresholds, reward amounts and exceptions against the current source. Do not replace small details with a broad personality summary. Keep an explicit no-invention list for missing family history, destinations, routines and mechanics.

## Operational behavior contract: what, when and how

For each implemented activity or interaction record:

| Required field | What the author must settle |
| --- | --- |
| Trigger and eligibility | Actual event/need/request; identity, current body, progression and permission prerequisites |
| Place and presence | Reachable destination, room/space, actual actor/worker, real listeners and usable fixtures |
| Priority | Hard commitment or urgent need versus customer/guest engagement, discretionary chores, rest and leisure |
| Start and cost | Controller action, time, stock/funds/tools, reservation and confirmation required before commitment |
| Progress | Visible ongoing activity, posture/equipment, saved progress and cadence; discussion is not completion |
| Interruption | Player response, queue/customer handling, stop/departure acknowledgment, partial use/effects and resumption |
| Outcome and cleanup | Exactly-once resources/items/payment, dishes/containers/laundry, satisfaction and saved receipt |
| Memory and portrayal | What was actually witnessed/said, who knows it, elapsed time, matching voice/mood and contextual variety |
| Failure and absence | Closed/unstaffed, blocked room/body, missing supplies, refusal, interrupted travel, offline/stale AI and safe exit |

Availability and mood need their own facts. Being physically present does not imply being awake, working, willing to socialize, available for romance or authorized to disclose information. Waiting in a queue does not grant an appointment or permission. A schedule describes intent until the controller records reachable movement and work. Urgent needs and hard commitments can interrupt, but ordinary departure must be acknowledged naturally. Quiet or a short answer is valid; no mandatory chatter or model request every minute.

## Representation and memory checklist

- Give stable public identity and form aliases; keep original-player identity and undisclosed history private. Separate directed relationship from appearance recognition, mastery and consent; trust describes the relationship tier.
- Supply current clothing/appearance, actual location/time/light, ongoing activity, fatigue/needs when recorded, actual audience and the latest expressed message. Follow-up questions stay on the current topic; background work must not replace the answer.
- Distinguish player claims, witnessed facts, accepted commitments, proposals and resolved outcomes. Recognizing a name typed by the player is not knowledge of hidden events. Record confirmed nicknames/preferences only through an authored memory event; do not invent personal familiarity.

- Keep secrets in author/controller data. Select only the particular authorized disclosure fragment for a recipient; never send a full secret dossier and rely solely on “do not reveal it.” Numeric eligibility does not force disclosure or grant room access.
- Use approved room text/layout and asset provenance. Text-only requests do not see image pixels. Narration respects body senses, room barriers and permitted viewpoint, even when the owner interface can display more information.

A business uses the same character standard plus a room/fixture/service matrix. For each relevant field identify its author source, runtime source, permitted audience, frontend packet path and backend provider-fact path.
